title: Events after the Reporting Period
summary: Prescribes when an entity adjusts its financial statements for events after the reporting period and the disclosure of such events, converged almost exactly with IAS 10, including the non-adjusting treatment of proposed dividends.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS – Closely Converged with IAS 10
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 10 reproduces IAS 10's adjusting/non-adjusting event distinction and dividend treatment almost exactly. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
